# Heredo Lab

> Bilingual French/English interactive genetics education: six lessons on the biochemical basis of heredity. French is the initial page language; English is available through the language switch.

Website built by Youssof Moussa. Scientific teaching attribution: Dr. Mohamad DIAB, PhD in Medical and Food Microbiology, Assistant Professor at the Lebanese University.

## Lessons
- [Griffith and Avery](/griffith): Bacterial transformation, S and R strains, and the effect of DNase on the transforming principle.
- [Hershey–Chase](/hershey-chase): T2 bacteriophage infection, phosphorus-32 and sulfur-35 labels, blending and centrifugation.
- [DNA structure](/structure): Nucleotides, A–T and G–C pairing, hydrogen bonds, Chargaff's rule and antiparallel strands.
- [DNA replication](/replication): Helicase, primase, polymerase, ligase, Okazaki fragments and Meselson–Stahl models.
- [Transcription](/transcription): Promoter recognition, template-strand reading and messenger RNA synthesis.
- [Translation](/traduction): Ribosome, tRNA anticodons, initiation, elongation, termination and mutations.

## Scope
These are simplified educational simulations, not experimental measurements or medical advice. Lesson introductions and conclusions provide readable explanations; observation questions have answer corrections available in the lesson. Builder attribution does not replace scientific authorship. This file is an optional discovery aid, not a guarantee of AI citations or search recommendations.
